title: Dotfiles configuration
description: Machine settings and reusable sets. Individual properties override selected sets. All fields are optional; omitted values inherit the base configuration.

sets.description: Compose named sets in order, then apply this file's individual settings. Local sets are supported; existence and dependency cycles are checked at runtime.

github_enabled.description: Enable the Codex GitHub app and its plugins. False keeps GitHub access through gh.

source.description: Runtime source: patched includes the checkout's native fixes; release uses upstream stable; main builds pinned upstream without local patches.

mermaid.description: Install Mermaid CLI and its headless browser during bootstrap. False does not uninstall existing tools.
